notes.title: Update V 1.9 More Upgrades + Polish
notes.notes:
Another major update brings Tomb Explorer VR closer to Full Access, let's go! Prove your not a bot , share, comment and make a review to show support for this game.
This update brings an additional layer of polish to the game based on countless recommendations and emails since EA launch a year ago in Aug. This was a big list and clears the way to the next stage of updates which includes the save system and more action boss combat into the game.    
[previewyoutube="rpAR2Ma20S8;full"][/previewyoutube]

New Major Features
 Menu Controller Layout Reference UI The menu now offers a controller layout image and button mapping reference for each of the popular headsets, Oculus Meta, Index Valve, and Vive Pro Controllers. You can now quickly review what button and functionality is available by accessing the pause menu anytime in game.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492988/08839cfe8cbfffe61c26d55b10eb1b4f5b251ff5.jpg"]

 Player Backpack Glow light Slot  This new slot allows player to attach the flashlight to the backpack to illuminate dark areas while climbing. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492988/5b4d713f971f02805f8baf026511aea5775e9056.jpg"]

Petra Map In - Game Tutorials  Many players suggested the tutorial map should be optional so we made it optional in recent updates, and now updated the first map to allow for players to learn as they go through the map progressively as required to create a smoother player experience. If you completed the tutorial map these in game tutorials will be removed.

notes.title: Update V 1.7 Hydra Boss Upgrade
notes.notes:
Another major update brings Tomb Explorer VR closer to Full Access, let's go! make a review and share to show support for this game.

This update brings Hydra serpent boss upgrade, revamped Petra revelation map, spider a.i upgrade, pistol upgrade with bullet tracers, Mayan Intro Map Polish and Maya guide polished and new expedition grouped level menu along with more features including Teleporting with item in hand, to prep game for a full release experience.


Save system implementation will be added in the coming updates as time permits on a level per level basis until all bugs are caught and polished.   
[previewyoutube="gqoEfj3OmJ0;full"][/previewyoutube]


New Major Features


Hydra Boss + Map Upgrade Polish
The Mayan Underground Map has been updated along with the massive Hydra Serpent Boss upgraded for full release. The map is now over 50% percent more optimized, smoother navigation, and objectives simplified. The experience is now steady action where you need to disarm the hydras shield and shoot it to take it down!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492988/7c83f83b12fdeb8d9c8bb5a776cdc11cf276f79b.jpg"]



 Spider AI Update + Pistol Update + Tracer Bullets. 
The spiders have been upgraded to a more aggressive Attack behavior \[ they wont just flee after one hit anymore ] + hit reacts, sdfx, fx, etc ] and the pistol gets green emissive iron sight, smooth reload + projectile speed increase + tracer rounds to help with aiming.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492988/81e7c60cdc4f92afdae945fab0bb3816935d3f86.jpg"]

 New Menu upgrade - Expedition Areas + Tombs Of Fortune 
The level menu has been upgraded to account for the enormous amount of maps available in the campaign. This makes it easier to navigate and offers players three ways to jump in and play through each Expedition Location. Tombs Of Fortune will be our new Challenge Maps Section focused on speed and offering leader boards to crown the top tomb explorer. Perhaps even prizes?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492988/f2a718bdf0738551b4ac938ca8ed911f047e1865.jpg"]

Petra Map Expedition Maps Revamped For Linear Experience 
The Petra maps have been further optimized and revamped for linear navigation to help avoid confusion and simplify objectives. This makes the experience much more smoother. Also prepped for the incoming Petra Boss!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492988/8595d8d462575bb941fe3c73e0a4a72f619d7822.jpg"]

Mayan Intro Map Upgraded
The Lighting has been updated to account for medium settings with an improved shadow casting and optimization. + Maya \[ you guide ] has been upgrade with mouth morph targets and fixed hair shader. She looks gorgeous and realistic when she now looks at you. Just keeping up to date with the beautiful graphics customers expect from tomb explorer.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492988/a0f4020e30070b7f338c5d657b56c41c546d788c.jpg"]

Player Teleport Feature Updated... \[ You can now teleport with items in hand ]

notes.title: News Update + New Game Announcement
notes.notes:
📢 Dev Update: A Message to Tomb Explorer Fans + New Game Announcement

Hey Tomb Explorer fans —
It’s been a couple months since our last update. After more than 8 months of continuous updates, polish, and new content, we can confidently say that Tomb Explorer VR is a completely different game than it was at launch. Many of you have noticed too — as reflected in reviews — It now stands as a full release-quality experience—aside from some ongoing development of the in-game save system, as requested by the community post launch."

But let’s talk about the reality behind the scenes.

🎯 The State of Early Access & PCVR

Early Access was once about supporting cool ideas in development, but now it’s treated as a guarantee of polished, AAA-quality games — even from tiny indie teams. These expectations are not sustainable, especially for PCVR developers. Gamers are just not investing anymore to help build something.

And here’s the hard truth:
Tomb Explorer VR makes almost no money.

We’re just two indie devs, self-funded, building games out of love for PCVR. Despite almost no algorithmic or influencer support (unless you're sponsored), we’ve delivered:

    🔹 15+ PC quality maps

    🔹 AAA visuals & new VR physics tech

    🔹 Various Weapons + Tools [ Bows / Pistols / Bull Whips / Fire Torches ]

    🔹 Full soundtrack

    🔹 Tons of enemies, traps & puzzles

    🔹 Two bosses

    🔹 A complete story campaign with cinematic dialogue maps

That’s far more than most Early Access VR titles, which often launch with one, two or three levels max, government funded studios with multiple team members and then iterate post-success. We’re old-school — we build first, then release. That was our flaw. 

💡 What’s Next?
We’re adapting. To survive, we’ve split efforts:

👷‍♂️ One of us is still working on Tomb Explorer VR updates - [ gradual integration of per level in-game save system + new content ]
🎮 The other has built something new: The Descent VR

And don’t worry — Tomb Explorer VR is NOT abandoned.
In fact, we’ve got a big update and sale coming this May!
We’ve been on Steam for over five years, and every game we’ve released has gotten long-term support — more than we can say for some bigger studios.

⚠️ A Quick But Important Note:

Lately, we’ve seen suspicious negative reviews — new accounts with single reviews, often arriving during sales using cheap currency conversions to make one off reviews, likely linked to bad actors who’ve previously harassed our brand over the years in reviews, forums, and discord.

It’s a known tactic in the already brutal PCVR market, where Steam’s algorithm gives little support to small indie VR devs building EA Games.

If you’ve enjoyed the game, please consider leaving a review. It helps fight back and makes a real difference for us.

🔦 Now Announcing: The Descent VR

Built solo by one of us (with some help from the other), The Descent VR is a tighter, darker horror adventure. It’s much smaller than Tomb Explorer, but packed with atmosphere, tension, and mystery along with the high quality you expect from our games.

[previewyoutube=1HDahrkLS70;full][/previewyoutube]

🎮 Support us and support PCVR:
👉 Wishlist or grab it on Steam

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2972480/THE_DESCENT_VR/

Thanks for standing with us.
We may be small — but we’re not going anywhere.

– Celeritas Games

notes.title: Update V 1.2.4 Intro Map + Petra Map Upgrade
notes.notes:
Thanks for supporting Tomb Explorer EA development and please make a recommended rating to show support for our work in progress. We'd really appreciate it. Much more updates are coming!

As we continue to develop the save system, we have also revamp some of the maps in preparation for it. A more linear workflow to be precise. We have completely revamped and simplified the Petra Tomb Map to make it more fun! 

In addition to that, we have upgraded the Intro Beach Map Graphics details and polished the animations stutters etc. Above all we have added a brand new character model to replace the previous model for your sister Athena. 

New Features


 Petra Map Revamp Upgrade 
[Various Major changes including removed previous tutorial section, game play path redesigned, more linear and less confusing, more fun shorter and polished climbing sections, and better use of 360* Exploration Vantage points. Hello, Explorers! First off we would like to apologize to everyone for significant delays... There's a saying in game development, that 10% is game development and 90% is fixing Bugs and Polish! This is partially the cause for delays but that would not be the entire story.
 
The truth is we have added additional content to ' fill in ' what was deemed to be missing after fixing the majority of bugs, this work has revealed a much higher quality experience, which in turn revealed "weaker spots". 

For this reason we have added much more to the game to make it the complete experience we can be confident with. I will explain below!

EARLY ACCESS EXPECTATIONS

PREVIOUS EARLY ACCESS LAUNCH EXPECTATIONS
“The Early Access version of the game currently includes the core game play mechanics and features six completed levels set in three unique location environments. Players can expect over four hours of game play duration in the current version.”

notes.title: Tomb Explorer VR Release Delayed.
notes.notes:
Hello, Explorers! Today, we announce a delay for the release of TombVR. We are working hard on delivering the Early Access version; however, to us, this still means providing a solid gaming experience worthy of Full Access. Due to scheduling issues behind the scenes, we have mismanaged our time frames and require more time for testing and addressing feedback issues. This will ensure the highest quality product during the Early Access phase!

RELEASE DELAY: The release date will be pushed back to ETA FEBRUARY! The official date will be sorted out ASAP! We apologize for any inconvenience and unmet expectations. We continue to work hard to provide the BEST ADVENTURE EXPERIENCE IN VR!

INDIEGOGO SUPPORTERS PRE-RELEASE VERSION: As promised for your support, you will be receiving a pre-release copy under Non-Disclosure Agreements shortly. This ensures that supporters are rewarded first, and we receive extra feedback to further polish the game. We will contact those relevant with details.

VR SOCIAL MEDIA AWARENESS: Many VR influencers and websites have still not covered this game, which is concerning for indie developers. The VR market is small, while the quality and content we have put into Tomb Explorer VR should easily stand out!

We ask our followers and fans to let influencers and VR websites know to cover Tomb Explorer with a simple email and/or comment on their VR platforms. It only takes a few minutes and should make a huge difference.

Please follow us and Wish-list the game and prepare for the adventure of a life time in VR!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969920/Tomb_Explorer_VR/
